Precision Fermentation Cost Explorer

Food-grade β-lactoglobulin (the main whey protein), ovalbumin and ovomucoid (egg-white proteins), β-casein (the main cheese protein), lactoferrin, and serum albumin for cultivated-meat growth media, made by a secreting K. phaffii strain in fed-batch fermenters of up to 200 m³ and dried: 10 kt of protein a year (lactoferrin 250 t, the size of its market; albumin 1 kt). Each protein has its own purification: membranes for BLG, ovalbumin and ovomucoid, isoelectric precipitation for casein, cation exchange for lactoferrin and albumin. Move the strain levers and see the minimum selling price, whether a real fermenter can run the design, and how the price compares with whey, egg white, casein, lactoferrin, bulk albumin, milk and eggs.

What the price is made of

Reference cases from the report

What this is. A cost with a capital charge of 14.6% of investment a year (7.5% over 10 years), not a market price. It excludes R&D, licences, regulatory work, sales and first-of-a-kind premiums.

Limits. A 200 m³ fermenter transfers at most 200 mol O₂ per m³ of cell-free liquid per hour (about 130 per m³ of broth at the base cell density; Humbird's air-sparged value) and removes at most 25 kW/m³ of heat; a batch must start at least 30% full, with glucose fed at 500 g/L; and cells secrete at most 40 mg of protein per gram per hour, a judgment about 8 times the base design and above any published K. phaffii value. A design that breaks any of these is marked; its price is shown but cannot be achieved as designed. The minimum fill and the feed concentration are design choices: with a 600 g/L feed the ceiling rises (report, Q3).

Market prices. Export unit values from UN Comtrade and Eurostat, deflated to 2025 dollars. Per kg of protein they assume 80% protein for whey (the minimum for its trade code; more isolate in the mix would lower the per-protein price) and 81.1% for egg white; "per kg powder" compares the same export prices per kg of product with our powder's cost per kg. The 2026 whey spot is from USDA Dairy Market News narrative quotes. Lactoferrin prices are reported ranges (trade press and reports, grade C). Our figures are production costs with a return on capital, not selling prices: a seller would add margin, sales and distribution.

Milk and egg equivalents. The price of replacing the protein of a litre of milk (33.7 g) or of one egg's white (3.64 g) with PF protein, beside what the litre or the egg costs. This flatters PF: charging the whole price of milk or eggs to their protein makes them look dearer per gram, when fat, lactose and yolk carry part of that price. The same egg white bought as dried egg white cost $0.035–0.077 per egg in 2015–2025, and a litre's whey protein bought as WPC80/WPI was 11%–21% of the farm milk price in the same year.
